title: Read research effects before committing science
description: Four saved commanders enter an authoritative development campaign. A commander reads all eight research choices through keyboard controls while another player's private state remains unchanged. Reading and choosing do not submit an order. Capability flags come from the real private projection. Fixed admission/catalogue clocks and developer entitlement are explicitly labelled harness controls; this is not hosted scheduling or full research-effect acceptance.

steps.description: Open each commander's economy through keyboard controls and inspect the saved research target.
steps.acknowledgement: Both private instruments show the authoritative navigation selection before any draft change.
verifications: No research write or receipt occurs; the complete campaign, both private projections and saved identity remain unchanged.

steps.description: Use the keyboard to inspect scanning. Read the effect before choosing whether to queue; no research order is sent.
steps.acknowledgement: The local selection acknowledges the chosen track and displays its capability-aware effect; the other commander's selection stays authoritative.
verifications: No research write or receipt occurs; the complete campaign, both private projections and saved identity remain unchanged.
The complete selected explanation and queue control remain readable in the bounded research panel.
